# Security Policy

The full policy lives in the docs: [Security](https://vernllm.dev/docs/security) (or `apps/docs/content/docs/security.mdx` if browsing the repo).

Summary: only the latest published npm version receives fixes. Please report vulnerabilities privately via [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/LakBud/vernLLM/security/advisories/new) rather than opening a public issue.
